[[Little John]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260729|July 29, 2026 game update]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
:[[Energy]] +5

==Acquisition==
;[[Core]]
*[[The Fissure of Woe]]
**[[Chest of Woe]]
*[[The Underworld]]
**[[Underworld Chest]]

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as there are no other axes that deal chaos damage. 

It is possible to create a [[slashing damage]] version of this item with:
*One of the following [[axes]]:
**[[Battle Axe]] from crafter [[Vaughn]]
**[[Cleaver]] from crafter [[Shichiroji]]
**[[Winged Axe]] from collector [[Gahnlar]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
* [[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Axe Haft]]
* Perfect [[Axe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following [[axes]]:
**[[Winged Axe]] from crafters [[Shausha]], [[Hadusi]], [[Bolereh]], [[Tehshan]], [[Sende]], or [[Rahmdah]]
**[[Spiked Axe]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Axe]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Axe of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Balthazar's Axe]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Axe]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Dwarven Axe]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Envoy Axe]] from crafter [[Jessie Llam]]
**[[Norn Axe]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Axe]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Axe]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Axe]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Axe]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Axe]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
* Perfect [[Axe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
* Perfect "[[I Have the Power!]]" inscription

==Trivia==
This axe uses the same skin as the [[Mammoth Axe]].

==Notes==
*The [[enchantment]]s and [[energy]] boost make this item (plus [[Padraic]], [[Rajazan's Fervor]], [[Sharp Pointy Stick]], [[Spirit of the Forgotten]] and [[Totem Axe]]) especially popular among [[55 monk]]s/necromancers and [[Vow of Silence]] runners along with many other [[spellcaster]]s.
